mods.name: Jimbob's Custom Characters
mods.author: Jimbob · Discord jimbob1111
mods.description: Extra playable characters, plus an in-game character creator. Clone a vanilla sheet, set a base (segway is 2), and it shows up as a new slot on the character menu.

mods.name: Jimbob's Multiplayer Mod
mods.author: Jimbob · Discord jimbob1111
mods.description: Full-screen public room browser, password-protected and friends-only rooms, Steam invites, lobby chat and easy mode switching. Race in Ghost Multiplayer or interact in one host-run Shared Physics world. Created by Jimbob.
